A LITTLE ABOUT US

More than coffee.
A feeling.

Café Aura is imagined as a welcoming neighbourhood escape — a place for first dates, long conversations, quiet pages and one more cup. We believe the best moments are often the simplest ones.

✦
Thoughtful ingredients
A focus on comforting flavours and carefully prepared favourites.
✦
Made for slow moments
A warm, relaxed atmosphere that invites you to stay a little longer.
✦
A cup with your name on it
Friendly service and little details that make every visit special.
